verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own marketing says it plugs the phone system into CRMs such as Salesforce and HubSpot, so a first-party CRM integration exists. Nothing in the evidence confirms that calls and texts are logged automatically or matched to the right contact. The call-log API, Embeddable and Workflow Builder are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented automatic call logging to the CRM, documented SMS logging, contact-matching behavior, setup or integration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
